name: Stormbreaker
description: (Tag:blade)(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:weapon)A mastercraft Uru axe-hammer complementing Thor's powers, telekinetically commandable, granting flight, immense physicality, and regeneration.
